label: Generar Release .deb y .tar.gz (Linux)
command: cmake -B build-release -G Ninja -DCMAKE_BUILD_TYPE=Release && cmake --build build-release && cd build-release && cpack

label: Configurar CMake (Windows)
command: $vsPath = & "${env:ProgramFiles(x86)}\Microsoft Visual Studio\Installer\vswhere.exe" -latest -property installationPath; Import-Module "$vsPath\Common7\Tools\Microsoft.VisualStudio.DevShell.dll"; Enter-VsDevShell -VsInstallPath $vsPath -SkipAutomaticLocation -DevCmdArguments "-arch=x64 -host_arch=x64"; Remove-Item -Recurse -Force build-win -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue; cmake -S . -B build-win -G Ninja -DCMAKE_BUILD_TYPE=Debug -DVCPKG_TARGET_TRIPLET=x64-windows

label: Compilar y Ejecutar (Windows)
command: $vsPath = & "${env:ProgramFiles(x86)}\Microsoft Visual Studio\Installer\vswhere.exe" -latest -property installationPath; Import-Module "$vsPath\Common7\Tools\Microsoft.VisualStudio.DevShell.dll"; Enter-VsDevShell -VsInstallPath $vsPath -SkipAutomaticLocation -DevCmdArguments "-arch=x64 -host_arch=x64"; if (!(Test-Path .\build-win\FronterMind.exe)) { cmake -S . -B build-win -G Ninja -DCMAKE_BUILD_TYPE=Debug -DVCPKG_TARGET_TRIPLET=x64-windows }; cmake --build build-win; if ($LASTEXITCODE -eq 0) { $env:PATH = "C:\Qt\6.12.0\msvc2022_64\bin;$PWD\build-win;$env:PATH"; .\build-win\FronterMind.exe }
